name: top_connected_metric_uncountable
statement: {X : Type*} [MetricSpace X] [PreconnectedSpace X] (x y : X) (h : x ≠ y) : ¬ (Set.univ : Set X).Countable
closed: ∀ {X : Type*} [MetricSpace X] [PreconnectedSpace X] (x y : X) (h : x ≠ y), ¬ (Set.univ : Set X).Countable
informal: A connected metric space with two distinct points is uncountable — the image of z ↦ dist x z contains the interval [0, dist x y] by the intermediate value theorem, a nondegenerate real interval is uncountable, and images of countable sets are countable.
type: ∀ {X : Type u_1} [inst : MetricSpace X] [PreconnectedSpace X] (x y : X), x ≠ y → ¬Set.univ.Countable
